clauses.title: Inclusive growth, sustainable development and well-being
clauses.text: AI should benefit people and the planet by driving inclusive growth, sustainable development and well-being.

clauses.title: Human-centred values and fairness
clauses.text: AI systems shall be designed to respect the rule of law, human rights, democratic values and diversity, with appropriate safeguards to ensure a fair and just society.

clauses.title: Transparency and explainability
clauses.text: AI actors shall commit to transparency and responsible disclosure regarding AI systems to ensure people understand outcomes and can challenge them.

clauses.title: Robustness, security and safety
clauses.text: AI systems shall function in a robust, secure and safe way throughout their life cycles, with risks continually assessed and managed.

clauses.title: Accountability
clauses.text: AI actors shall be accountable for the proper functioning of AI systems and for respecting these principles, based on their roles and context.
